notes.title: NEW LEVEL -- Archie's Asylum
notes.notes:
NEW LEVEL!
Archie's Asylum

Some bug fixes and gameplay changes.

notes.title: New Level - The Abattoir
notes.notes:
This update includes:
- New Level - The Abattoir
- Some minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Bigger isn't always better! ;)
notes.notes: We've drastically reduced the download size of the game and you can now adjust the master volume in the game settings.

notes.title: New Cave Level
notes.notes:
- The new cave level is here.
- Some performance improvements for the Maze level.
- Smarter AI.

notes.title: New theme song!
notes.notes: We have changed the menu music and have made some performance improvements.

notes.title: LOD's
notes.notes:
[h3]This update includes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]I have implemented LOD's more efficiently.
[*]Some general performance improvements.
[/list]

See ya soon!

notes.title: Abandoned Factory
notes.notes:
[h3]This update includes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]New Level - Abandoned Factory.
[*]Head bob has been added for more realistic movement.
[*]The flashlight has had a makeover.
[*]CLOWN can now jump up onto obstacles to get to the player and is smarter in general.
[*]Improved lighting and atmosphere.
[/list]

See ya soon!

notes.title: Maps
notes.notes:
[h3]This update includes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Minimaps have been added to all 3 existing levels.
[*]A large map (can be accessed by pressing "M") has been added to the Twisted Forest level.
[*]Character will automatically stop crouching when player starts to sprint.
[*]Bug fixes regarding the flashlight specifically.
[*]Minor bug fixes here and there.

[*]More obstacles and items have been added to the Twisted Forest level. I will be adding more in the next couple of days.
[/list]

Thank you to those who provided suggestions for things they'd like to see.
See ya soon!
